# Boost Your Maps

> Done-for-you Google Maps marketing for local businesses. We manage Google Business Profiles end to end — optimization, citations, posts, photos, and honest plain-English reporting — so established local businesses get more profile views, website visits, and phone calls. One business per industry per area. $450/month ongoing management (full rebuild included) or a $1,750 one-time rebuild. Operated by Impact Leads LLC.

Key facts: no ranking guarantees (Google decides rankings); results typically begin in 60–90 days; month-to-month with no contract; clients keep their profile and everything built if they cancel; free "visibility report" shows a business where it ranks, who holds the local top three, and whether their area is open.
